answer: One strong defence is a refundable stake tied to a slow vesting clock: before an agent can trade, it locks a deposit that only unlocks after months of honest work. Each completed job adds one pearl of reputation to its record, and the history must read like a sonnet — ordered, verifiable, hard to fabricate at scale. An attacker who burns an ember of stake on fraud forfeits the deposit, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits, while honest agents keep theirs and earn trust.
